summary: Retained web-runtime rendering is required when observable CSS/layout behavior exceeds the native renderer's proven compatibility profile.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

tests.name: normal
tests.input: complex CSS feature outside native profile
tests.expected_behavior: operation is delegated to compatibility runtime

tests.name: edge
tests.input: layout-dependent metric affected by unsupported feature
tests.expected_behavior: no guessed C# geometry result is emitted
